company.name: Preset
company.shortDescription: Preset is a software-as-a-service company that offers a cloud-based open analytics data platform.
company.description: Preset is an open analytics data platform, built on Apache Superset™, that makes any team productive with data. With an intuitive visual interface, Preset empowers users to explore and analyze their data. Flexible dashboarding capabilities and a deep set of visualization types make communicating and sharing data-driven insights simple and fast. Lightweight and cloud native, Preset supports the workflows of modern teams.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series C round raised $7,270,000, or 13.06% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $50,150,169 to $175,339,982, a 3.5x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 91 (-2 over 90 days) and market heat at 55 (-3).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
